propositions: Replace duplicate pass-record producers with one process-finalizer writer that records minimal JSON to refs/reconciler/last-pass before releasing refs/reconciler/lock using observed-OID CAS with bounded retry (three attempts, 100ms/200ms backoff)
Implement canonical rebar bridge status and hidden rebar bridge-status as identical read-only entry points with unified parser exposing identical verdicts, exit codes, and output formats

Status verdict precedence is PAUSED > RUNNING > FOREIGN > FAILED > STALE > HEALTHY with NEVER_RUN only when no record and no live lock; canary additionally detects CRASHED via two read-only live-fence snapshots

Derive writer and status identity from explicit REBAR_ENV_ID or stable local:<repo-env-id> from .env-id; missing or unreadable .env-id is a hard configuration error; preserve inbound event metadata and LEGACY_JIRA_ENV_ID unchanged

Canary transitions from GitHub Actions heartbeat polling to durable status source by default while retaining explicit REBAR_CANARY_HEARTBEAT_SOURCE=github-api rollback for one release; no canonical heartbeat API query

Reject observed lease_secs over 480 seconds immediately before the fixed ten-minute workflow budget; hold heartbeat through last-pass CAS then release promptly; recorded fence is provenance only while RUNNING and CRASHED use live lock snapshots
